name: Covidence Refresh Consolidation Plan
description: Move Covidence create and reimport refreshes onto the `project_mart_refresh_state` worker path by marking seeded judgment writes dirty and removing the route-level `queueImportedArticleRefreshes` calls.

userStories.title: Mark dirty from seeded Covidence judgments
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `seedCovidenceHumanJudgmentsFromConfig` to mark affected project articles dirty so Covidence imports refresh review marts through the worker-owned dirty-state path instead of route-level queueing.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `src/server/services/covidenceImportService.ts` so `seedCovidenceHumanJudgmentsFromConfig` calls `getProjectMartRefreshStateService().markProjectsDirtyAtomically(...)` for the owning project and affected article ids in the same transaction.
Title/abstract imports and full-text judgment-only reimports advance `app.project_mart_refresh_state` and `app.project_mart_refresh_article_state` even when `project_article` scope does not change.

Keep `syncCovidenceProjectScopeFromConfig(...)` responsible for added and removed full-text scope articles, and add or update service regression coverage for both the title/abstract path and the judgment-only full-text reimport path.

userStories.title: Remove reimport route queue trigger
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the Covidence reimport route to rely on dirty-state updates instead of `queueImportedArticleRefreshes` so project refresh orchestration has one source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove `queueImportedArticleRefreshes(...)` from `src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidence.ts` and remove the unused import.

Update `src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidence.test.ts` to assert the route no longer calls the queue helper while still clearing seeded judgments and running the scope and seed steps.
Leave non-Covidence import flows that still use `src/server/services/articleImportStoreService.ts` unchanged.

userStories.title: Remove create route queue trigger
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want new Covidence datasource creation to rely on dirty-state updates instead of the old queue so create and reimport follow the same refresh path.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove `queueImportedArticleRefreshes(...)` from `src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceCreate.ts` and remove the unused import.

Update `src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceCreate.test.ts` to assert the create route no longer calls the queue helper while still creating the datasource, project, prompts, scope, and seeded judgments.
Keep the create response payload for datasource, project, prompts, and stats unchanged after the refresh-path swap.
